tools.name: lr_price_moves
tools.description: FREE, no key. Biggest house price moves by postcode district (England & Wales): median sold price over the latest 6 complete months vs the same months a year earlier, top risers and fallers (districts with 30+ sales in each period). Also GET /drops/price-moves (JSON) or ?format=text. Source: HM Land

tools.name: price_paid_discover
tools.description: Free peek: up to 5 HM Land Registry Price Paid sales for a postcode / outcode / town (e.g. M1). Cached 24h. Soft-Offer outbound is OFF.

tools.name: price_paid_pack
tools.description: Paid Price Paid pack for a UK postcode / outcode / town. Returns Stripe Checkout URL (£0.49). Soft-Offer outbound is OFF.

tools.name: area_comps_pack
tools.description: Paid compound comps pack: Price Paid sample + summary stats + risk_flags. Returns Stripe Checkout URL (£0.49). Soft-Offer outbound is OFF.

tools.name: redeem_pack
tools.description: Instructions to redeem a paid Stripe Checkout session. Pass session_id from checkout.
